act_array: uint8, source 'active' flag (above stop-codon mean + 1.96 SD)
cnt_array: uint16 little-endian min(InputCount_1, InputCount_2), capped at 65535

layout.kind: projected sequence space, NOT molecular geometry
layout.tile_rows: residue 1 (V183 in the TrpB numbering used by the source study) x residue 2

score.definition: replicate growth rates mu_1, mu_2 minus the per-replicate mean over stop-codon rows (same as core loader); not max-normalised; not the source's row-specific mu_k-bg columns

noise_model_constants.origin: copied from evolve/data.py at origin/work/core a8c0090 (core worker's declared, frozen noise model); half-width eps_i = ceil(kappa * sd_bin / 2 * 1e6) / 1e6; kappa is an ASSUMED sensitivity multiplier, not a confidence level

score.stored_as: int16 little-endian, value x 50000 (resolution 2e-5), -32768 = not measured
